post.description: Finding auction properties in an area; listing sold (closed) auctions with winning bids; locating a listing_id for get_listing, get_valuation or get_auction_status.

city.description: City name, for example Atlanta. Combine with state.

county.description: County name without the word County, for example Miami-Dade. Combine with state.

limit.description:
Page size.

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 100; default 20.

listing_type.description: Listing states to include. closed means sold. Defaults to ["active"].

offset.description:
Continuation: pass next_offset from the previous page.

Provider reference: minimum 0; maximum 100000; default 0.

query.description: Free text (address, ZIP, city) sent to the site's search box filter.

sort.description:
Site sort keys: auction date (default), newly added, price low-high / high-low, sqft low-high / high-low, recommended.

Provider reference: allowed values ["auction_date_order", "asset_activation_dt_sort_desc", "valuation_estimate", "valuation_estimate desc", "sqft", "sqft desc", "resi_sort_v2", "recommended_v2"]; default "auction_date_order".

state.description: Two-letter US state code, for example GA. Pattern: ^[A-Za-z]{2}$.

200.description:
Search Auction.com residential listings by state, city, county, ZIP or free text, with status, asset type, property type, size and price filters, sorted and paginated by offset. Returns one page of listing cards with auction dates, starting bids, bid state and property facts.

The response contains the tool result directly.

The provider identifies `listings` as the primary payload key.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `address` | object |  |
| `asset_type` | string | BANK_OWNED, FORECLOSURE, ... |
| `auction` | object |  |
| `bathrooms` | number |  |
| `bedrooms` | number |  |
| `bidding` | object | Online auction segment state from the search index; null for in-person (live) auctions or when the index has no segment. |
| `coordinates` | object |  |
| `currency` | string |  |
| `event_code` | string |  |
| `listing_id` | string | Auction.com listing id; input to get_listing, get_valuation and get_auction_status. |
| `listing_status` | string | Fine-grained site status (SALE_PENDING, SALE_PENDING_CLEARED, AUCTION_IN_PROGRESS, SALE_GATEKEEPING, CLOSED, NO_SALE, ...). |
| `listing_status_group` | string | Coarse group: ACTIVE, SOLD, ... |
| `listing_status_label` | string | The label the search page shows (auction date range or status text). |
| `lot_size_acres` | number |  |
| `marketing_tags` | string[] |  |
| `occupancy_status` | string |  |
| `primary_photo` | string |  |
| `product_type` | string | DAY_1_REO, TRUSTEE, ... |
| `property_id` | string |  |
| `square_footage` | number |  |
| `structure_type` | string |  |
| `structure_type_group` | string |  |
| `url` | string | https://www.auction.com/details/{slug}-{listing_id} |
| `urn` | string | adc:listing:{listing_id} |
| `valuation` | number | Site's estimated value, USD. |
| `year_built` | number |  |


These are the provider's documented fields. Field requiredness, nullability and nested object structures are specified only where the descriptions explicitly say so.
